estimand: Relative position among eligible historical per-domain calibration fit records; not a clinician-population percentile.
fieldwork: heterogeneous historical source studies; not a single norming window

inputProvenance.producer: scripts/build_engine_inputs_k7.py — concatenates v13 byte-verbatim two-stage IIIC sdt_fits + spike sdt_fits (D2 invariant). V_B joint posterior NPZs are consumed by Layer 2 (assemble_outputs_k7.py) for s_j; per-rater (σ̂, θ̂) come from the byte-verbatim two-stage path per Phase-3.5 decoupling.

method.fitUncertainty: ell_hat=-log(sigma_hat); SE_ell=SE_sigma/sigma_hat; each bootstrap fit record receives a Normal(ell_hat, SE_ell) draw
method.name: two_level_rater_and_fit_uncertainty_bootstrap
method.samplingUncertainty: equal-weight fit rows resampled with replacement within domain

referenceLabel: quality-screened historical mixed-rater calibration fit cohort
requiredWarnings: Provisional historical calibration-cohort percentile; not representative clinician norms.
The 95% interval excludes unknown population-mismatch and source-composition bias.
Historical fit rows are the sampling units and are not asserted to be unique governed people across sources.
Percentile does not affect or replace the criterion-referenced CORTEX verdict.
Percentile is not percent correct and is not readiness/pass probability.
scale: ell=-log(sigma), frozen K=7 certification instrument scale
